hero.title: Impact & Accountability
hero.description: A worked example of composing the Impact Stats and Spend Breakdown patterns together on one page — two separate, standalone components presented as one cohesive section, never merged into a single component.

example.title: Combined example
example.description: This is what a site shows once it has both a year's outcomes and that same year's expense breakdown ready — the outcomes lead, the spend breakdown follows immediately below with no gap in between, and the cost-per-outcome highlight ties the two together.

impactStats.title: Impact Stats Pattern
impactStats.description: Full documentation for the lifetime stat tiles and optional period-by-period bar chart, on its own.

spendBreakdown.title: Spend Breakdown Pattern
spendBreakdown.description: Full documentation for the rolled-up spend-category tiles sourced from a filed tax return, on its own.

standard.title: Standard
standard.twoComponents: Still two separate components under the hood — ImpactStatsSection and SpendBreakdownSection are composed on the page, never merged into one. A site can show this combined section, either pattern alone, or neither.
standard.samePeriod: Every figure on both sides must come from the same reporting period — pairing a lifetime impact total against one year's spending (or vice versa) is misleading, even if every individual number is accurate.
standard.sharedHeading: Give the title/description to the first component only (typically ImpactStatsSection) and leave the second title-less, so the pair reads as one section rather than two stacked demos.
standard.costPerOutcome: The cost-per-outcome highlight is always computed by the page from the same same-period totals shown on both sides — never estimated or computed by either component itself.
standard.onlyWhenBothReady: Only build this combined page for a site once it genuinely has both a real impact dataset and a real spend dataset for the same period — don't pair one real side with a placeholder on the other.
